name: io.github.vstockma/handelskalender-api
title: Trading Calendar & Public Holidays (x402)
description: Stock exchange trading days, hours, live market status (28 exchanges) and holidays (247 countries).

tools.name: trading_day
tools.description: Use when an agent needs to know if a stock exchange trades on a given day (default today) before scheduling orders, reports or alerts. 28 exchanges incl. NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE, Xetra, Euronext, SIX, Tokyo, HKEX, Shanghai, ASX. Returns holiday name, hours in local time + UTC, half days, lunch breaks, pre/after-market (Nasdaq, Xetra), live status, next open/close, previous/next trading day. Official exchange calendars only; bad input: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

exchange.description: Exchange MIC code, e.g. XNYS (NYSE), XNAS (Nasdaq), XLON (London), XETR (Xetra), XPAR (Paris), XTKS (Tokyo), XHKG (Hong Kong). Common names also work (NYSE, Xetra, LSE). Free list: GET /v1/exchanges.

date.description: Day as YYYY-MM-DD. Optional, default: today in the exchange's time zone.

tools.name: trading_calendar
tools.description: Use when an agent plans ahead and needs every closure of a stock exchange for a whole year: holiday names, half days, late openings, regular hours, count of trading days. 28 exchanges incl. NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE, Xetra, Euronext, SIX, Tokyo, HKEX, Shanghai, ASX. Official exchange calendars only; bad input or uncovered year: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

exchange.description: Exchange MIC code, e.g. XNYS (NYSE), XNAS (Nasdaq), XLON (London), XETR (Xetra), XPAR (Paris), XTKS (Tokyo), XHKG (Hong Kong). Common names also work (NYSE, Xetra, LSE). Free list: GET /v1/exchanges.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Optional, default: current year.

tools.name: market_status
tools.description: Use when an agent needs to know right now which stock exchanges are open: open, lunch break, pre-market, after-hours or closed (with holiday name), local time, exact next open and close in UTC. One call checks up to 28 exchanges (default all) incl. NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE, Xetra, Euronext, Tokyo, HKEX, Shanghai, ASX. Official exchange calendars only; unknown exchange: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

exchanges.description: Comma-separated MIC codes or names, e.g. XNYS,XETR,XTKS. Optional, default: all exchanges.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Use when an agent needs all public holidays of a country for a year (planning deliveries, payments, deadlines, staffing). 247 countries, 2026-2028, optional state/province (region=) for regional holidays. English and local names, weekend days of the country, moon-dependent dates flagged as estimated. Bad input: HTTP 400 before payment, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. AT, DE, US, GB, FR, JP, IN, BR, AE. 247 countries; free list: GET /v1/holiday-countries.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2027. Optional, default: current year. Covered: 2026-2028.

region.description: Optional state/province for regional holidays, e.g. BY or DE-BY (Bavaria), CA (California), 9 (Vienna). Listed per country in GET /v1/holiday-countries.

tools.name: business_day
tools.description: Use when an agent must know if a date is a business day in a country, or compute a due date: weekend or holiday (with name), previous/next business day, date plus N business days (add=), business days until a date (to=). 247 countries, 2026-2028, optional state/province (region=), local weekends (e.g. Fri-Sat). Bad input: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. AT, DE, US, GB, FR, JP, IN, BR, AE. 247 countries; free list: GET /v1/holiday-countries.

date.description: Day as YYYY-MM-DD. Optional, default: today (UTC).

region.description: Optional state/province for regional holidays, e.g. BY or DE-BY (Bavaria), CA (California), 9 (Vienna). Listed per country in GET /v1/holiday-countries.

add.description: Optional: number of business days to add (negative = go back), -260 to 260.

to.description: Optional end date YYYY-MM-DD (>= date): count business days from date to it, both included.
